entities.summary: Scott Kosmachuk is a Canadian professional ice hockey forward who currently plays for the Vienna Capitals of the ICE Hockey League (ICEHL). He was originally drafted 70th overall in the 2012 NHL Entry Draft by the Winnipeg Jets.
